title: Wheat Field with Cypresses
alt: A painted landscape with a yellow wheat field, green trees and tall dark cypresses beneath a swirling blue and white sky.

prompts.title: Follow a line
prompts.question: Choose one visible brushstroke. Describe its direction, then find another part of the painting where that direction changes.

prompts.title: Compare two passages
prompts.question: Compare a small area of sky with a small area of field. Which marks, edges or colors make them feel different to you?

prompts.title: Ask the collection
prompts.question: Write one question that the image alone cannot answer. What kind of source would you consult to investigate it?
